correctness.rationale: The exact seventy-two-facet complex reconstructs f=(14,86,144,72). After tree contraction the graph-cycle lattice is Z^73. A fixed maximal facial-relation minor has determinant 5, while the full relation matrix has mod-five rank 72; therefore the integral quotient has order exactly five. A nonzero mod-five cocycle evaluates nontrivially on all 164 nonfacial triangles, so each is a generator. Exhaustive cell-preserving permutation search proves the full automorphism group has four elements of orders 1,2,4,4 and acts on H1 by all four units.

value.rationale: For a lens space with H1=Z/5, the shortest homology layer has two intrinsic unoriented generator classes. Determining that every nonfacial triangle is essential, that the two classes occur in the exact balanced ratio 82/82, and that the full C4 simplicial symmetry realizes every unit of Z/5 gives a complete structural description of the first combinatorial systolic layer, not a routine recomputation of H1.
